# Map of the platform

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_map.py. Do not edit by hand: run `uv run --project platform python scripts/gen_map.py` from the repository root. -->

Generated at commit `42cfb585` · projection version `86` · 48 stage modules · 216 event types · 220 index tables · 272 service modules · 184 MCP tools · 366 CLI commands · 28 skills.

Read [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) first. This file answers *where*: for each stage module, the events, models, index files, tables, task kinds, gates and checks it owns, and the services that name its events; then every MCP tool, CLI command, service and skill with what it reaches. Links are found by name (see the script's docstring), so a missing link means the code does not name the thing, not that no relation exists. Paths are relative to `platform/src/factory/` unless they start with `plugin/`.

| `factory screen disagreements` | `access`, `access_log`, `agreement`, `human_pass` | List the works the two passes disagree on, each pass's decision and quote; at full text, first the unresolved cannot-assess works a human m… |
| `factory screen join` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening` | Join a pass as a human screener, once per stage. |
| `factory screen next` | `access`, `access_log`, `agent_view`, `human_pass`, `screening` | Serve the next batch of your pass, as an agent sees it, with a file to fill in. |
| `factory screen record` | `access`, `access_log`, `agent_view`, `human_pass`, `screening` | Record your verdicts on a held batch, from a file or by prompts. |
| `factory screen resolve` | `access`, `access_log`, `agreement`, `human_pass` | The human's verdict on a disagreement, on an unsure single-pass work, or, at full text, on a cannot-assess work (single-pass or dual-pass). |
| `factory screen-check band` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check`, `search` | Draw records of a pass, stratified by relevance score, for the person to label. |
| `factory screen-check example` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check` | Make a disagreement an example of a criterion, by a protocol amendment. |
| `factory screen-check label` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check` | A person's label on one drawn record. |
| `factory screen-check list` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check` | The draws of a stage. |
| `factory screen-check measure` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check`, `search` | Draw a measurement batch: fresh, disjoint from tuning batches and example records. |
| `factory screen-check report` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check` | Agreement per band (band check), the disagreements (tuning), or the agreement on a current measurement batch. |
| `factory screen-check tuning` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `screening_check`, `search` | Draw a tuning batch: fresh records the agent screens first, then the person labels. |
| `factory search chase` | `access`, `access_log`, `chase`, `human_pass` | Chase citations from the included works; with neither flag, in both directions. |
| `factory search slice` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `pubmed_slices` | Split a capped PubMed query by date; without --run, show the plan and write nothing. |
| `factory seeds admit` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `seeds` | Look up an explained seed-admission miss by its identifier and admit what is found. |
| `factory seeds explain` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `seeds` | Record why a positive seed was not retrieved, and the route planned for it. |
| `factory seeds split` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `seeds` | Draw and record the hold-out split of the positive seeds. |
| `factory serve` | `serve_http` | Run the MCP server on stdio, or with --http over authenticated streamable HTTP. |
| `factory server check` | `server_check` | Check that this root can host projects; exit 1 when it cannot. |
| `factory server init` | `access_log`, `server_init` | Make this root a lab server: the lab registry with you as admin, `.server/`, `.gitignore`. |
| `factory shared rebuild` | `shared_mining` | Rebuild the shared store from every project's log and print its state hash. |
| `factory shared status` | `shared_mining` | Sync the shared store and list each project, the opted-out and the unreadable ones too. |
| `factory site build` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `site` | Build every stale product and the hub page (`<project>/site/index.html`). |
| `factory site serve` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `site_server` | Serve the hub on 127.0.0.1; a stale product is rebuilt when it is opened. |
| `factory site status` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `site` | Each product with its build time and whether it is stale. |
| `factory snowball compare` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `snowball` | A backward round's resolved references against the chase rounds. |
| `factory snowball core list` | `access`, `access_log`, `core_works`, `human_pass` | The marked core works and the seeds' works, which are core without a mark. |
| `factory snowball core mark` | `access`, `access_log`, `core_works`, `human_pass` | Mark a work core: a forward round with forward_core_only may start from it. |
| `factory snowball core unmark` | `access`, `access_log`, `core_works`, `human_pass` | Take a work's core mark back (a positive seed's work stays core). |
| `factory snowball plan` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `snowball` | A dry run: what a round would do, the candidates ranked, and the plan's gaps. |
| `factory snowball run` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `snowball` | Record and run a round (the researcher's go-ahead is this command). |
| `factory status` | `access`, `access_log`, `agent_view`, `human_pass`, `project` | Show a project's rigor mode, event counts and task queue. |
| `factory suggest` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `suggestions` | Computed hints from the other projects under the root, each with its reason. |
| `factory taxonomy agreement` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomy_agreement` | Agreement of the two passes per dimension (computed; quotes are never compared). |
| `factory taxonomy coverage` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | Pattern coverage of the taxonomy over a descriptor miner's pass-A quotes. |
| `factory taxonomy derive` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | Derive a classification miner from a registered taxonomy and print its specification JSON, ready for `factory miner register`. |
| `factory taxonomy diff` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | The computed difference from version A to version B. |
| `factory taxonomy list` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | Every registered taxonomy version, by name then version. |
| `factory taxonomy proposals` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | The change proposals against the taxonomy, each with its status. |
| `factory taxonomy register` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | Register a taxonomy version from a specification file (the researcher's act). |
| `factory taxonomy view` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `taxonomies` | The specification of one registered version, or the registered versions of a taxonomy. |
| `factory terms list` | `terms` | Terms with the number of their applications by status. |
| `factory terms promote` | `terms` | Promote a label key to a term as the researcher. |
| `factory terms retire` | `terms` | Retire a term; a region rule naming it is then refused. |
| `factory terms revise` | `terms` | Record a new version of a term. |
| `factory terms suggest` | `terms` | Label keys applied to enough distinct targets to be worth promoting. |
| `factory token issue` | `access`, `access_log`, `credentials`, `lab` | Issue a token. |
| `factory token list` | `access`, `access_log`, `credentials`, `lab` | Tokens by id, with owner and expiry; never a secret. |
| `factory token revoke` | `access`, `access_log`, `credentials`, `lab` | Revoke a token for good. |
| `factory trace` | `access`, `access_log`, `agent_view`, `human_pass`, `trace` | The chain from REF as an indented tree, seeds included (the human view). |
| `factory user add` | `access`, `access_log`, `lab` | Register a person. |
| `factory user deactivate` | `access`, `access_log`, `lab` | Stop a person acting; their events stay attributed. |
| `factory user link` | `access`, `access_log`, `lab` | Link an external identity to a person. |
| `factory user list` | `access`, `access_log`, `lab` | Every person ever registered, with their state and lab roles. |
| `factory user reactivate` | `access`, `access_log`, `lab` | Let a deactivated person act again. |
| `factory versions list` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `versions` | Newer versions on a route, published-version links, refused links and preferences. |
| `factory versions prefer` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `versions` | Make a document the one `default_conversion` serves for the work (human act). |
| `factory view coverage` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `view_coverage`, `views` | The coverage map, complete: methods and confirmed ideas by comparability group, counts only. |
| `factory view horizon` | `access`, `access_log`, `horizon`, `human_pass`, `views` | Activity per year: ideas, lineage edges and record counts, with the corpus horizon. |
| `factory view onion` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `onion`, `views` | The onion view, complete (the researcher's variant): rings of works around the included corpus with their processing depth. |
| `factory view timeline` | `access`, `access_log`, `horizon`, `human_pass`, `views` | The record timeline and per-year frontiers of one comparability group. |
| `factory vocabulary approve` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `properties` | Approve a proposed definition; until then it is unusable. |
| `factory vocabulary list` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `properties` | The approved properties (`V@` names them). |
| `factory vocabulary merge` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `properties` | Merge two properties of one kind; reversible with `vocabulary unmerge`. |
| `factory vocabulary reject` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `properties` | Reject a pending proposal, or withdraw the approved definition of the key. |
| `factory vocabulary unmerge` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `properties` | Undo the latest merge of a property. |
| `factory watch plan` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `protocol` | Print the current protocol's watch_plan as JSON. |
| `factory watch run` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `living_hooks`, `watch` | Run the due watch cycle; exit 0 nothing due or complete, 1 partial or failed, 2 invalid. |
| `factory watch status` | `access`, `access_log`, `human_pass`, `watch` | Per source: last cycle, next due, mode, window start and failures. |
| `factory workspace` | `access`, `agent_view`, `reviews`, `workspace` | A person's sessions, tasks, proposals and reviews on this project. |
